fullTextZH: 你们好，今天我是一个有名的人。
fullTextEN: Hello everyone, today I am a famous person.

fullTextZH: 我觉得素清老师也知道我。
fullTextEN: I think Teacher Suqing also knows me.

fullTextZH: 她要问我很多很多问题。
fullTextEN: She wants to ask me many, many questions.

fullTextZH: 然后素清老师要猜一猜。
嗯，你们也猜一猜我是谁。
fullTextEN: Hmm, you also guess who I am.

fullTextZH: 对，英国有很多很多有名的人，嗯。
fullTextEN: Yes, there are many, many famous people in Britain, hmm.
I, I am a woman, hmm.

fullTextZH: 第三个问题，你的头发是什么颜色？
fullTextEN: Third question, what color is your hair?

fullTextZH: 哈哈哈，我觉得白色的头发，嗯，
fullTextEN: Hahaha, I think white hair, hmm,
I have a fourth question, hmm.
70 years old, how old were you?
When I died, I was 96 years old.

fullTextZH: 你很老很老的时候你死了。
fullTextEN: You died when you were very, very old.

fullTextZH: 对，我很老的时候，96岁的时候死了。
fullTextEN: Right, when I was very old, I died at 96.
Then I have a sixth question, hmm.
What do you do for work?
I, I have a lot of work.
I need to meet many people every day.
I need to read many letters, oh.
I also need to write letters.
Okay, then I have the 7th question.
What kind of clothes do you like to wear?
I like to wear the same color.
I also wear a pink skirt.
I also wear a pink hat.

fullTextZH: 你的衣服和你的裙子有一样的颜色，
fullTextEN: Your clothes and your skirt are the same color,

fullTextZH: 我的雨伞也要一样的颜色，哈哈。
fullTextEN: My umbrella also needs to be the same color, haha.

fullTextZH: 你的雨伞也要一样的颜色啊。
fullTextEN: Your umbrella should also be the same color.
What do you like to do?

fullTextZH: 好，我非常喜欢骑马，是的。
fullTextEN: Okay, I really like horseback riding, yes.
you have a lot of money.

fullTextZH: 可能我有一些钱，哈哈哈。
fullTextEN: maybe I have some money, hahaha.

fullTextZH: 哼，我觉得你是一个很可爱的人。
fullTextEN: Hmm, I think you are a very cute person.

fullTextZH: 中国人觉得你很可爱，很可爱。
fullTextEN: Chinese people think you are very cute, very cute.
I think your name is Elizabeth, right?

fullTextZH: 中国人觉得你很可爱，很可爱。
fullTextEN: Chinese people think you are very cute, very cute.

fullTextZH: 你，你觉得我的狗比我可爱吗？
fullTextEN: Do you think my dog is cuter than me?
It's okay, I think so too, oh.

fullTextZH: 你的狗真的很可爱，很可爱。
fullTextEN: Your dog is really cute, very cute.

fullTextZH: 你的狗有很大的屁股，对不对？
fullTextEN: Does your dog have a big butt, right?
The legs are short, yes, yes.

fullTextZH: 因为你喜欢很大的屁股，对不对？
fullTextEN: Because you like big butts, right?

fullTextZH: 可能我觉得他们走路的时候很可爱。
fullTextEN: Maybe I think they are cute when they walk.
What do you like to eat?
I really like to eat chocolate.
Hmm, do you eat chocolate every day?
I like to eat chocolate every day.
Then I want to drink champagne every day.
British people like to drink alcohol.
Hmm, do you like other animals?
An elephant, and also a crocodile.

fullTextZH: 在英国，英国所有的天鹅都是我的。
fullTextEN: In the UK, all the swans in the UK are mine.
